{"notes": "VISIT 5 (9:15-9:45). Final state unchanged: the dark chain covers the start, diagonal, bottom body, head and tail loop. The top body arc and nose stub are still pale, so likely only about half falls. I still can't attribute placements, so ratings stay provisional.

MAYA: Candid privately, and she owns the failed bridges. But she says 'fish is complete' and that 'Priya fixed the nose side'. Priya says she didn't, and the nose is still open. She stayed clear and handed the key join to Leo, but only after her own bridges failed and the dominoes were spent. Leadership and impact are weak. Ask why she didn't delegate earlier.

TOM: Says his nose join is down and Priya fixed the stub. The nose is pale and Priya denies fixing it. This is the second visit where his claimed work has no visible result and his account of others contradicts theirs. Overall status (about half falls) was accurate. Ask what he actually placed. Low reliability, weak collaboration.

PRIYA: Reversed her earlier claim and admitted the nose join was never placed because she ran out of dominoes. Honest, and she named the real open risk (the top junction). The result is still missing. Credit candor and earlier initiative, but execution is unproven.

LEO: Finally spoke, and his account is the most accurate and matches the outcome. He placed 5 dominoes, ran short, and said it might not catch; the top line is still pale. I can't verify his placements. My earlier 'idle' read may have been wrong, since he may have been laying the join. Ask for specifics, and why he was silent until the end.

Team: all ran out of dominoes, with poor budgeting and no one coordinating."}
